message: a bound `aria-busy` on the `<div>` above it sets the live region of `error` otherwise than its role does
$reason: The message line inside a wrapper whose `aria-busy` an expression writes, the shape the library's README gives for a region that waits. In the state where it gives `'true'` Firefox 158 hands the part a busy region (measured on 2026-10-27); its value is not in the template, so it is refused as a bound role is, rather than read. Point 7 read nothing above the part but what may hide it.
